_readme: Many-to-many join between photos and people.
id      — stable identifier for the photo; never reuse one.
src     — path under materials/, as served (leading slash optional).
people  — list of character slugs from characters.json appearing in it.
A photo listed here shows up on every linked character's page.
Shortcut for single-person shots: drop the file straight into
materials/photos/people/<slug>/ and it is picked up with no entry here.
